#Dim tResultSet As %SQL.StatementResult
Set tStatus = $$$OK Try {
New $NAMESPACE Set $NAMESPACE = "%SYS"
Set tCreatedOn = $ZDATETIME($H,3)
Set tUTCBeginDateTime = ##class(%SYS.Audit).ConvertLocalHToUTC($ZDTH(pBeginDateTime,3)) Set tUTCEndDateTime = ##class(%SYS.Audit).ConvertLocalHToUTC($ZDTH(pEndDateTime,3))
Set tQuery = "SELECT " _ "ID, " _ "EventSource, " _ "EventType, " _ "Event, " _ "UTCTimeStamp, " _ "EventData, " _ "Description AS Description, " _ "Namespace AS Namespace, " _ "Username AS Username, " _ "Pid AS Pid " _ "FROM %SYS.Audit" Set tWhereClause = " WHERE (UTCTimeStamp BETWEEN ? AND ?)"
If (pEventSource '= "") { Set tWhereClause = tWhereClause _ " AND EventSource = '" _ pEventSource _ "'" } If (pEventType '= "") { Set tWhereClause = tWhereClause _ " AND EventType = '" _ pEventType _ "'" } If (pEventName '= "") { Set tWhereClause = tWhereClause _ " AND Event = '" _ pEventName _ "'" } If (pUsername '= "") { Set tWhereClause = tWhereClause _ " AND Username = '" _ pUsername _ "'" } If (pDescriptionKey '= "") { Set tWhereClause = tWhereClause _ " AND Description [ '" _ pDescriptionKey _ "'" } If (pEventDataKey '= "") { Set tWhereClause = tWhereClause _ " AND EventData [ '" _ pEventDataKey _ "'" }
Set tQuery = tQuery _ tWhereClause
Set tStatement = ##class(%SQL.Statement).%New() Set tStatus = tStatement.%Prepare(tQuery) $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus) Set tResultSet = tStatement.%Execute(tUTCBeginDateTime,tUTCEndDateTime)
While (tResultSet.%Next(.tStatus)) { $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus)
Set tAuditLogId = tResultSet.%GetData(1) Set tEventSource = tResultSet.%GetData(2) Set tEventType = tResultSet.%GetData(3) Set tEvent = tResultSet.%GetData(4) Set tUTCTimeStamp = tResultSet.%GetData(5) Set tEventData = tResultSet.%GetData(6) Set tDescription = tResultSet.%GetData(7) Set tNamespace = tResultSet.%GetData(8) Set tUsername = tResultSet.%GetData(9) Set tPid = tResultSet.%GetData(10)
Set tNewItem = ##class(IHC.EAI.Report.AuditLog.Data).%New() Set tNewItem.CreatedOn = tCreatedOn Set tNewItem.AuditLogId = tAuditLogId Set tNewItem.Description = tDescription Set tNewItem.DescriptionKey = pDescriptionKey Set tNewItem.EventData = tEventData Set tNewItem.EventName = tEvent Set tNewItem.EventSource = tEventSource Set tNewItem.EventType = tEventType Set tNewItem.Pid = tPid Set tNewItem.Username = tUsername Set tNewItem.Namespace = tNamespace Set tNewItem.EventDataKey = pEventDataKey
Set tNewItem.LocalTimeStamp = ##class(%SYS.Audit).ConvertUTCHToLocal($ZDTH(tUTCTimeStamp,3))
Set tStatus = tNewItem.%Save() $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus) } $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus)
} Catch eException { Set tStatus = eException.AsStatus() } Quit tStatus
